jsntrs answered {} before jsntrs-ck4: check_placeholder_position walked an invocation's procedure and arguments but not the group-by hung off it. A group-by reduces the *result* of the call — 'The reduce operator can be used as the last step in a path expression to group and aggregate its input sequence into a single object' (docs.jsonata.org/path-operators) — so its pairs are ordinary expressions, not argument slots, and a ? in one replaces nothing.
A partial application carries no group slot of its own, so the group-by lands on a wrapper node; this case pins that the wrapper is walked too.
